minutes.headline: Sewer Commission voted to recommend Wright Pierce as Pond View 40B peer reviewer and to oppose any dedicated single line to Leominster.
minutes.summary: The Sewer Commission, with the vice chair presiding, spent most of the meeting on the Pond View 40B project ahead of the next day's ZBA hearing. It chose a peer reviewer, took a position that properties along the route must be able to connect, and reviewed sewer capacity. It also assessed two privilege fees, approved the 10/11 minutes, heard the business manager's report and adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission voted to use Wright Pierce as peer reviewer for the Pond View 40B project, with the recommendation going to the next night's ZBA hearing.
A motion barred a single dedicated line from the project to the Leominster hookup and asked for full connections along the route; the captions do not make the result audible.
The business manager is to send the ZBA a memo with the peer review recommendation, the Wright Pierce estimate and the capacity figures.
Commissioners discussed Fitchburg capacity as nearly used up after the project, while Leominster has more room.
Privilege and extension fees for two properties were moved to assessment, and the 10/11 minutes were approved as corrected; results of the fee votes are not explicit.

why_it_matters: The commission's recommendation and capacity figures feed the ZBA's review of Pond View, which affects how much sewer capacity remains and whether homes along the route can connect.
The minutes say peer review costs are to be charged to the developer, and that pump station upkeep would likely fall to the town if the system were accepted, which bears on future sewer costs.
